class: A builder brief's 'Budget: N min, M tool calls' line is text the agent may ignore; the only hard stop is the agent type's maxTurns (builder: 100), so a 40-call budget does not stop a builder before 100 calls, and fix rounds cost 2-3x what the brief allowed.
mechanism: The agent_budget_required hook only checks that a Budget line exists and is below 80% of maxTurns; nothing counts the agent's calls against the Budget line during the run. Builders keep working past the budget when tests or e2e runs need more iterations.

first_seen.where: W-066 round 7 (ran to its turn limit without pushing), a second builder the same day (handover 2026-10-15b 'Misses'), and W-065 phase 3 round 2
first_seen.evidence: W-065 p3 r2 builder: brief docs/process/brief-W-065-p3-r2.md 'Budget: 30 min wall-clock, 40 tool calls'; the agent's completion record: 74 tool uses, 549 s.

fix: Not built; filed upstream as Startup-Factory#98 (harvest). Structural options: a builder variant per budget tier with maxTurns set to the tier's call budget, or a PostToolUse counter that stops the agent at its Budget line. Meanwhile the orchestrator records each overrun here.

detection.note: Overruns are seen only in the completion record's tool-use count. 2026-10-16: the GC-1 scorecard reads the completion record's tool-use count for every dispatch; a general-purpose agent has no maxTurns at all.
